scope: Bounded read-only source and current shared Swift/JavaScript contract audit. Only this report and task scratch written. No production edits, graph compilation, source rebuild, test, native replay, national graph search, external consultation or delegation.

source.membershipMethod: Targeted SQL text prefilter plus exact decoded member type/reference comparison; no relation membership invented. Immediate onward ways selected by exact node reference, not geographic proximity.

decisiveAssessment.currentPhysicalSectionAdmission: No direct-way alternative is currently accepted by cn-reviewed-physical-sections/1. Compiler lines123-132 and manifest policy line6 require nonempty original owner relations covering every edge way, before operator/passenger checks. All proposed missing-membership ways remain rejected under current manifest.
decisiveAssessment.sharedContractFinding: Mandatory OSM relation membership is not a universal shared N02/physical graph requirement. Swift and JS consume sourced operator/line/class/track identity and original survey geometry; reviewed OSM registry paths identify source ways without any required relation field. Existing CN named-way lines also have sourceRelation=null and no sourceRelations.
decisiveAssessment.noLoweringJudgment: Direct original name+ref+operator for every contributing versioned way can supply stronger per-way identity/agency attribution than merely inheriting an agency from an inventory relation with missing own-way agency. This is an evidence-based alternative source form already represented by CN named-way compilation, not evidence of relation membership. It is not universally stronger in every fact: only a real relation proves membership in that relation. A separately explicit reviewed source mode could preserve the semantic identity/topology/passenger standard, but would change the current CN manifest admission policy and needs a deliberate parent decision; it is not admitted by this audit.
decisiveAssessment.passengerIndependence: Own operator/name/ref do not establish passenger use. Any alternative must independently retain the current positive source passenger or reviewed official named-corridor evidence requirement and every existing exclusion, crossover safeguard, original-node adjacency/version, country, published identity, exact attachment and station-binding rule. Matching names/refs must never manufacture geometry or attach distinct source nodes.
decisiveAssessment.existingPublishedIdentityCaveat: Exact original bureau operator strings cannot silently become the different existing published operator 中国铁路. An unchanged existing identity requires its own explicit reviewed agency/identity evidence; otherwise the original way keeps a separate identity and only an evidenced physical junction can join it.
decisiveAssessment.legalOwnership: An OSM operator tag is operating-agency evidence. Legal infrastructure ownership is not asserted.
decisiveAssessment.G101Verdict: Withheld. 1067140203v3 has direct name/ref/passenger and real topology but no own operator, owner, network or relation membership. It fails the proposed strict all-direct identity/agency form as well as current relation-inventory form.
decisiveAssessment.G6045Verdict: Withheld. Direct stop-area binding exists for track15 way845559683 only; five other missing-agency candidate ways lack a stop member or track_ref. Generic station operator propagation cannot cover the six-way set. All six are service=siding, a separate current exclusion. Fixed X/XXIV anchors remain unchanged.

contractEvidence.fact: Current CN physical manifest explicitly says exact original nodes/adjacent ways and owner relations required; operator and passenger reviews explicit.
Nonrepeated original-node path, exact relations/version/member-way coverage, exact node coordinates/versions and way adjacency/versions; inactive/freight/foreign/service exclusions.
Original-way operator is checked against every way; passenger tags, original passenger relation or reviewed named official corridor are separate modes; crossover remains protected.
Existing regression explicitly rejects source way removed from original relation inventory; not executed.
Existing same-country compiler accepts original named-way operator identity separately from original relation operator identity.

Named original-mainline fallback uses original way geometry. Name corroborates identity and contributes zero edges. The locally constructed member list is a named-way corridor inventory, explicitly not an original OSM relation; published provenance has sourceRelation=None at709.
Physical graph scopes identity by operator/line/class and track/source identifiers; passenger station groups do not establish connectivity.
Reviewed osmTrack retains own identity, source path and attachment bounds; endJunction requires explicit foreign identity and same-train evidence. No original-relation requirement.
Shared registry OSM source structure records provider/license/ways/retrieved/cache, with no required relation field.
Raw N02 and neutral section fields decode to the same identity; original source_node_ids are retained.
JS identity explicitly uses operator/line/class/level/track ID; no OSM relation gate.
JS uses RailroadSection consecutive vertices and validates one original source ID per source vertex.
JS reviews country, evidence, existing surveyed endpoint, OSM source ways, exact identity, path, attachments and ambiguity; no relation membership requirement.

PNEParentQuestion.assessment: This way has direct original name峨广线/ref0084/operator中国铁路成都局集团 and eight consecutive original edges. Those own tags provide source-bound physical identity and agency without pretending relation membership. Unlike1067140203 or the GZS six, it is a suitable candidate for considering an explicit direct-way provenance form. Admission remains withheld under the current physical manifest policy. Passenger use, precise official-corridor mapping, published-identity compatibility and both source attachments are separate questions; they are not proved by the three tags.
PNEParentQuestion.officialPassengerModeCaveat: Existing reviewed-official-corridor support binds relation sourceNames and sourceRelationIds at184-188. Reusing its underlying primary publication for a direct named/ref way could preserve the same passenger evidence quality if the document and exact corridor mapping really cover it; merely reusing a URL or route name is insufficient. No such new mapping is adopted here.
PNEParentQuestion.operatorCompatibility: Exact own operator string 中国铁路成都局集团 is retained. The current original-way-operator mode requires exact equality to row.identity.operatorName; do not silently equate this source string with a different published generic or expanded agency identity.
